description: This file declares the WaveChart class used for dev console wave sniffer data logging, including method signatures and class members.

classes.name: WaveChart
classes.description: Class used for managing dev console wave sniffer data buffer and related operations.

methods.name: addEvent3
methods.description: Adds an event with a name and message to the wave chart buffer.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the wave chart data buffer.

methods.name: publishIfFull
methods.description: Publishes the buffer if it is full.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes the current wave chart data.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full.

methods.name: isStartedTooLongAgo
methods.description: Checks if the waveform sniffer has been started too long ago.
